headline: Witchbrook January 28 2027
title: Witchbrook Release Date January 28 2027 | Cozy Witch Life Sim | Gaming News
video_script: Witchbrook, the cozy witch life sim from Chucklefish, finally has a release date: January twenty eighth, twenty twenty seven. It was announced during Nintendo's Indie World showcase on October twenty eighth. It comes to PC, Nintendo Switch, Switch two, Xbox and PlayStation five. Will you move to Witchbrook? Comment below!
description: Witchbrook by Chucklefish launches January 28, 2027 on PC, Switch, Switch 2, Xbox and PS5, announced at Nintendo Indie World on October 28, 2026. Sources: Game Informer, Gaming Trend.
joke: Finally a game where being late to class is fine because you can fly.
